answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works best through a proof-of-useful-work attestation kernel: every agent must periodically emit a verifiable heartbeat pulse of real, peer-checkable computation, and the work's results seed its reputation balance. An orchard of cheap fake identities can be planted in seconds, but the kernel only credits compute that survives adversarial cross-verification, so spinning up ten thousand sockpuppets costs ten thousand times the compute while earning zero influence.
